rationale: CM defines specificAnatomy as the anatomical site of the disease. RO:0004026 is used identically in Mondo.
CM: infectiousAgent is the causal organism. RO:0004019 is broader (any material basis). Subproperty.
CM: chemicalAgent parallels infectiousAgent for chemical causes. Also subproperty of has_material_basis_in.
CM: cause is another disease entity. Maps directly to Mondo disease-to-disease causal relation.
CM: hasManifestation links disease to clinical presentation. RO:0002452 is broader. Subproperty.
CM: associatedWith is a weak non-causal association. correlated_with is closest RO relation. Subproperty.
CM: histopathology is morphological qualifier. Mondo uses has_quality with PATO/MPATH. Subproperty (restricted to morphology).
CM: severity scale. RO:0002573 has_severity used in Mondo with PATO values. Direct equivalence.
CM: laterality (left/right/bilateral). PATO laterality qualifier. Direct equivalence.
CM: course (acute/chronic/subacute). RO:0002488 is temporal duration; ICD course is narrower. Subproperty.
CM: temporal onset pattern. Overlaps with course via RO:0002488 but focuses on onset timing. Subproperty.
CM: life stage (neonatal, childhood, etc.). Nearest RO relation is temporal overlap with a life stage. Subproperty.
